text:
Tariq: Heads-up — noticed per-route invoice preview counts are ~30m behind for EU after we flipped the priority-watermark flag on canary. Preview UI shows ~12k tokens but ingestion/aggregator shows ~8.5k. Anyone seeing this?

Maria: Which tenant/route? can you paste the quick logs and the preview run id?

Tariq: route=/v1/generate tenant=acme-eu preview_run=pr-20260320-1412. Logs from ingest-window (tail):
```
2026-03-20T14:12:01Z ingest-window INFO assign_watermark route=/v1/generate tenant=acme-eu watermark=2026-03-20T14:10:00Z max_lateness_ms=120000
2026-03-20T14:12:05Z ingest-window WARN drop_event event_id=evt_93a123 reason=late_by=190000ms priority=high shard=eu-2
2026-03-20T14:12:07Z route-aggregator INFO aggregate event_id=evt_93a124 tokens=320
```
So high-priority events are getting dropped because late_by > max_lateness. That explains the delta.

Kevin: We shipped a change earlier today to reduce max_lateness to 120s on canary to lower memory retention. Also enabled priority-tag routing to a separate shard — likely the shard has a stricter watermark.

Sophia: If priority events are being dropped, invoice preview will undercount. Two short options: increase max_lateness to 5m on canary, or enable a small persistent buffer queue for priority events with relaxed watermarking. I prefer the buffer route to avoid increasing memory pressure globally.

Maria: I can run a backfill from the WAL if the events are still retained. Tariq, can you confirm WAL retention window for eu?

Tariq: WAL retention = 2h; should be fine for a short replay. I can also kick a selective replay for tenant=acme-eu and route=/v1/generate if we decide. But let's try config first to avoid replay churn.

ingest-pager: ALERT: ingest-windowing-high-lateness tenant=acme-eu p95_lateness=192s triggered 14:13UTC

billing-bot: Invoice preview job pr-20260320-1412 tenant=acme-eu started=2026-03-20T14:15:00Z status=completed preview_count=8500 expected_approx=12000 source=route-aggregator-v2 :warning:

Kevin: Proposed plan: pause canary change for priority-watermark, bump max_lateness to 300000ms (5m) on canary only, and enable buffer queue for priority events. Maria to run backfill for events between 14:00-14:13 if WAL contains them. Rollout notes: config-only change, safe to revert quickly.

Maria: Running selective backfill now from WAL range 2026-03-20T14:00:00Z to 2026-03-20T14:13:00Z for tenant=acme-eu. ETA ~7m — will stream logs here.

Sophia: :thumbsup: to the bump. Also add an annotation on the dashboard for the config change and tie to rollout id r-2026-03-20-14 so product + finance can trace the preview delta.

Tariq: Doing the canary bump now (max_lateness -> 5m) on shard eu-2 for acme-eu only, and enabling priority buffer with capacity=50k events. Will monitor for 10m and report.

Kevin: If preview still low after 10m we'll trigger the full replay. Thanks all.

Maria: Backfill logs: 14:18:12 re-ingested 2,900 events from WAL for tenant=acme-eu. Posting re-run preview in ~2m.

billing-bot: Preview re-run pr-20260320-1420 tenant=acme-eu completed preview_count=11960 status=success :white_check_mark:

Tariq: Looks good — counts reconciled. Will open a short postmortem doc with config timeline and recommended permanent buffer + metrics (p95 lateness, buffer fill).

Kevin: Nice catch. Add a metric alert for priority-drop-rate > 0.5% in future.

Sophia: Agreed. Also let's add a small UX note in the Console: when preview delta > 10% show "ingest windowing in progress" tooltip so users aren't surprised.

Maria: Logged follow-ups: backfill-run id bf-20260320-1418, dashboard annotation r-2026-03-20-14, action items assigned in the postmortem draft.

Kevin: :ok_hand:
